## Summary

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the related issue (use
`Closes #...` only when this PR completes it).

## Change type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Build / maintenance

## Validation

List the commands run and results. Explain any relevant checks not run.

- [ ] Affected components build successfully, or a build is not applicable.
- [ ] Relevant tests pass; behavior tests were added/updated where appropriate.
- [ ] User, configuration and protocol documentation was updated where relevant.
- [ ] `node versioning/sync_version.mjs --check` passes where relevant.

## Context

Include screenshots for panel changes and note compatibility, plugin ABI,
persistence or deployment effects when applicable. Remove credentials and
private data from examples, logs and screenshots.
